summary: Validated the premium daily attendance view replication into Student and Admin-staff reports + Teacher regression. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passing for /api/asistencia/{profesores,administrativo,alumnos}. Frontend: all required data-testids present and flows render correctly with admin@elroble.edu on /elroble/asistencias.
verified_flows: GET /api/asistencia/profesores: response shape {fecha, resumen{total,completos,tardanzas,ausentes,justificados}, profesores[...]} with 7 columns and tipo=Profesor. resumen.total == len(profesores). Estado logic Ausente/Tardanza confirmed on real seed dates (2026-06-18 -> all 44 Ausente; 2026-05-19 -> tardanzas >= 1).

GET /api/asistencia/administrativo: shape {fecha, resumen, registros[...]} with tipo reflecting staff roles (e.g. 'Psicólogo','Auxiliar de Tópico','Auxiliar de Movilidad'). resumen.total == len(registros) (12 rows for elroble).

GET /api/asistencia/alumnos?fecha&grade_id&section_id: shape {fecha, resumen, registros[...]}; each item tipo=='Alumno'; horario_inicio configured (07:30 for 3 años A); missing grade_id/section_id -> 422.
Frontend Asistencias /elroble/asistencias: nav buttons btn-reports-students/teachers/maintenance all present.

Student Reports Por día: student-mode-day, student-day-grade (native select with grades incl. '3 años'), student-day-section, student-day-date, student-day-generate work. After 'Ver día' for 3 años A on 2026-06-18: 1 daily-summary block + 24 daily-row-<id> rows + daily-export-pdf rendered.
Student Reports Por rango: report-grade-select, report-section-select, report-generate-btn still present (OLD range report preserved).

Admin Reports Por día: admin-mode-day, admin-mode-range, admin-day-date, admin-day-generate, admin-day-today all present. Auto-loads today (12 rows). 'Hoy' and 'Ver día' both render the premium view (1 daily-summary + 12 rows + daily-export-pdf).
Admin Reports Por rango: maintenance-report-generate still present.

Teacher Reports regression: opens premium daily view, renders 5-card summary + 44 daily-row-<id> rows + daily-export-pdf. teacher-report-mode-day/month/custom toggles present (refactored to PremiumDailyAttendance).
critical_code_review_comments: attendance.py is ~1700 lines (close to threshold). Consider splitting daily-premium endpoints into a new sub-module if it grows further.
_extract_times duplicates the entry/exit parsing logic that is inlined in get_daily_teacher_attendance — small DRY win possible by reusing _extract_times there too.

Student schedule lookup in get_daily_student_attendance only reads from attendance_config.levels; if a school stores entry time elsewhere, alumnos will show null horario_inicio (acceptable but worth documenting).
test_credentials: admin@elroble.edu / 1234abc8 (subdomain elroble). Payment-block modal removed via JS during testing.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo data. Most students show 'Ausente' due to orphaned user_ids in seed (expected per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Student/Admin grade/section selectors are NATIVE <select> elements (use select_option, not role=option). Teacher report uses testids prefixed 'teacher-report-' (mode-day/month/custom, day-date, day-generate). PremiumDailyAttendance renders data-testid daily-summary, daily-card-{total,completos,tardanzas,ausentes,justificados}, daily-export-pdf, daily-row-<id>. Student Por día default loads on 'Ver día'; Admin Por día auto-loads today on open. To navigate between sub-reports, must go back via /asistencias or 'Volver al panel de asistencia'.
